title: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru

opinions.point: Many viewers found the episode unusually funny and enjoyed its deliberately absurd fanservice-focused comedy.
The ending sequence was repeatedly singled out as a memorable comedic highlight.
Several commenters praised the show's unapologetic silliness and said it remains consistently entertaining.
Some viewers felt the adaptation was too restrained visually for an ecchi series, while others were satisfied with its playful presentation.
A few viewers criticized the episode's uneven presentation and questioned some visual or story logic.

notes: The Reddit thread clearly matches Magical★Explorer episode 6 and has no season marker conflict. The displayed Reddit page did not expose a reliable score or complete comment count, so score is reported as 0 and the comment count reflects the substantive comments reviewed.
